bosses.intro_text: THREAT STATUS UNRESOLVED. DEFENSIVE ENGAGEMENT AUTHORIZED.

bosses.intro_text: Try not to die too quickly. I need to see the full reaction.

bosses.summary: A devotional biotech prototype that refuses to die cleanly.

bosses.summary: A tactical director who dismantles the player's best turns.
bosses.intro_text: You are not a crisis. You are an expense.

bosses.name: Compliance Engine AX-9
bosses.summary: A riot-break engine built to pacify whole corridors.

bosses.name: Ashfang Rook
bosses.summary: A raider leader who turns chaos into lethal tempo.
bosses.intro_text: You got all the way here just to die tired.

bosses.name: Furnace Hound
bosses.summary: A tracked scrap-war machine that fights like an animal.
